annotations.title: Remote jobs open to a country

description: How many live remote jobs a person living in a given country can actually take, and the newest of them. Most 'remote' listings are limited to one country; this applies that rule.

country.description: Where the job seeker lives: a country name or ISO code ("Nigeria", "NG").

limit.description: How many of the newest jobs to return, 1 to 20 (default 10).

name: remote_jobs_open_to_country
